entries.description: Read-only Model Context Protocol service answering only from the published static files. No inference, no writes, no sessions, no accounts.
representativeQueries: list the most recent federal publication digests
get the digest for 2026-09-04
what did the Federal Register publish yesterday

entries.description: RFC 9727 catalog of the static read files, with an OpenAPI 3.1 description and JSON Schemas.
representativeQueries: machine-readable index of daily federal digests
OpenAPI description of the FAPD files

entries.description: Every published digest day with its HTML URL, canonical Markdown path and teaser. The dated digests are the record.
representativeQueries: which dates have a published federal digest
teaser for each daily digest

entries.description: Every item observed so far for the current publication day, with honesty labels. Preliminary until the dated digest freezes.
representativeQueries: federal publications observed so far today
preliminary list of today's Congressional Record items

entries.description: Every source the pipeline ingests, plans to ingest, or found unavailable, with the statistics of our own ingestion. Not government publication.
representativeQueries: which federal sources does the digest ingest
sources that are unavailable to automated clients

entries.description: The most recent digest days as an Atom feed, for change discovery.
representativeQueries: subscribe to new daily federal digests
Atom feed of the most recent digest days

entries.description: Where everything is and how to read it faithfully.
representativeQueries: how should an AI agent use fapd.info
where are the machine-readable files on fapd.info

entries.description: Find and read the Free Agentic Publication Digester's validated daily digest of official US federal publications for a given date, and cite it correctly.
representativeQueries: read the federal publication digest for a given date
how to cite a FAPD digest item correctly

entries.description: Read the in-progress federal publication day from today.json, or a finished day's frozen listing, without mistaking preliminary or backfilled items for the day's news.
representativeQueries: what federal documents have been observed so far today
read a frozen day listing without counting backfill as news

entries.description: Understand which federal sources the digest covers, which are planned or unavailable, and how to read its ingestion statistics.
representativeQueries: which federal sources does the digest ingest and which are unavailable
how to read the digest's source health labels

entries.description: Check a Free Agentic Publication Digester digest against its public repository history and provenance manifests.
representativeQueries: verify a digest file against the public repository history
what a provenance manifest hash proves
